name: Bough Shadow
summary: In northeastern Ashenvale, Bough Shadow lies east of Forest Song beneath a colossal Great Tree. Its roots surround an ancient portal into the Emerald Dream.

sections.title: A Gateway to the Dream
sections.body: Bough Shadow gathers beneath a Great Tree whose roots wind around a natural crossing into the Emerald Dream. The Green Dragonflight guards the quiet grove. Emerald drakes such as Phantim and Dreamstalker circle above the canopy, while Emeraldon dragonspawn and oracles patrol the swirling green portal at the tree’s base. Mortals who approach without permission are turned away.

faq.q: What is the glowing green portal here?
aliases: what is the portal in bough shadow
faq.answer: The swirling vortex beneath the Great Tree opens directly into the Emerald Dream, Azeroth’s untamed spirit realm. Similar natural crossings lie elsewhere in the world.

faq.q: Why are green dragons guarding Bough Shadow?
aliases: why are there dragons in ashenvale
faq.answer: Ysera’s Green Dragonflight watches over the Emerald Dream and its passages into the physical world. Emerald drakes and dragonspawn patrol Bough Shadow to keep intruders and corrupting forces from crossing.

aliases: can i go through the portal
faq.answer: No. The gateway is sealed to mortals, and the elite dragonkin guards will attack anyone who comes too close.

angles.text: As a druid, you stand on sacred ground at Bough Shadow, where a natural threshold links Azeroth to the Green Flight’s domain and the Emerald Dream.
As a Night Elf, you find Bough Shadow deep beyond Forest Song. Its Great Tree and sleeping portal speak to the bond between the kaldorei and the Emerald Dream.
